art_direction: 珊瑚粉与淡紫星云聚成一枚小结，中心明亮，外围雾气柔和散开。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Form one compact nebula knot from muted coral and lavender clouds around a pale central glow. Keep its overall shape oval and slightly twisted, like two soft currents meeting. The brightest area should be small but not a pinpoint starburst. Let the outer dust fade gradually into deep plum space, with only a few embedded stars visible. Preserve broad cloud masses rather than intricate filaments everywhere. Center the nebula as a single readable subject, with no planets, text, or rainbow-colored effects. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
